query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='mozilla/donate-wagtail' AND number=273 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Fixing Footer UI on Donate
data.body: The footer on the donate site is looking good but there are still some tweaks to the UI that need to be made: **Image for reference:** **List of requirements** - [ ] Increase margin/padding below 'Protect the internet ...' to 24px - [ ] Increase margin/padding below 'Join our email list ...' to 24px - [ ] Increase margin/padding below email signup form field to 16px - [ ] The sign up button should share the same row as the form field and occupy 3 columns with 16px spacing between itself and the form field - [ ] _All_ text, except for links, should be white #ffffff at full opacity - [ ] All links should be #269 B7B9FA (as well as hover states for Donate, Legal, License, Participation Guidelines and Privacy) - - [ ] The language picker is missing @alanmoo is that within scope of this project? For further reference, the footer on https://foundation.mozilla.org/en/ is exactly how the footer should be

data.title: Fixing Footer UI on Donate
data.body:
@nicklee Footer is looking great! Some small tweaks:

## Desktop
- [ ] This is my fault, but on the sketch file the spacing _was_ 24px but on the foundation site it looks like we're using 16px spacing. Could you update it to that instead?
- [ ] Also the link in bottom right hand corner should be to foundation.mozilla.org and in the #b7b9fa colour

**Change to:**
![footer](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20977376/66142794-1cc4d580-e5d4-11e9-9e81-d94ef44d589d.jpg)

## Mobile
- [ ] The sign up button actually becomes full width below the sign up field form on mobile

**Current:**
![Screen Shot 2019-10-03 at 11 52 30 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20977376/66142920-4da50a80-e5d4-11e9-9087-fd820df31f27.png)

**Change to:**
![Screen Shot 2019-10-03 at 11 48 03 AM](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20977376/66142940-572e7280-e5d4-11e9-895e-cf3378a6fd0e.png)
